about_the_game:
Real-Time Tactics Action

  • Action RTS, Real-Time Tactics genre

  • Battle utilizing tactical elements such as suppression and cover

  • Various strategies through combinations of units and skills

Gameplay driven by tactical elements

Form a squad of 4 units and go into battle.

To win, you must create tactically advantageous conditions.

Seize a position that is advantageous for your units to take cover, but disadvantageous for the enemy.

Use your unit's skills in the most effective situation.

Make tactical judgments and give orders at every moment, such as attacking, defending, and retreating.

Welcome to our new commander

The long war between the Empire and The Kingdom Alliance has ended and an era of great chaos has arrived.

The player graduates from the military academy in The Empire of Fire, Ardensia and is appointed as a new commander.

Fulfill your assigned mission to resolve the chaos on the continent and embark on a journey to restore the Empire's status.

  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 or Higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 or AMD Ryzen3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 Ti
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 16.04 or Higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Ryzen5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
